# NovaMind AI — AI Talent & Workforce Readiness Report

**Reporting Period:** Q2 2026  |  **Prepared by:** People Operations  |  **Distribution:** CHRO, Portfolio Operations

## 1. Workforce AI Adoption

Active AI users (active AI adoption count) across the workforce this quarter: 482, out of 220 employees and vendors in the AI policy population scope plus an additional broader workforce base — representing 71% of the eligible 680-person total workforce. A sample of staff IDs (employee identifiers) tracked in the adoption dashboard includes EMP-3301, EMP-3402, and EMP-3588.

Weekly AI interactions (weekly AI usage count) per active user averaged 1,928 across the org this quarter.

| Tool                                                  |   Weekly Sessions |
|-------------------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| Copilot weekly sessions (copilot tool usage sessions) |             1,200 |
| Custom agent weekly sessions                          |               650 |
| Embedded analytics weekly sessions                    |               870 |

NovaMind's cross-portfolio AI capability score (AI maturity score) for this workforce readiness cycle is 3.8/5.

## 2. Productivity Impact

| Metric                                                | Value           |
|-------------------------------------------------------|-----------------|
| Output pre-AI per FTE (baseline productivity per FTE) | 120.0 units/FTE |
| Output post-AI per FTE (current productivity per FTE) | 169.2 units/FTE |

This reflects a 41% productivity uplift per employee following AI tool rollout in underwriting and customer support roles.

## 3. Talent & Capability Ratings

The following ratings were assessed by People Operations in partnership with the PMO this quarter (0–5 scale):

- **Talent readiness score** (AI talent maturity score): 3.4
- **Technical maturity score** (MLOps maturity score): 3.6
- **Governance maturity score** : 4.1
- **Strategic alignment score** : 4.3
- **Portco talent readiness rating** (company AI talent maturity rating): 3.4

## 4. Compliance & Policy Training

Total employees and vendors in scope under the AI usage policy (total entities): 220. Compliant entities (policy-compliant employees and vendors): 207, a 94.1% completion rate for mandatory AI usage and data handling training this quarter.

## 5. AI Intelligence Quotient (AIQ) Components

| Component                | Weight   |   Score |
|--------------------------|----------|---------|
| Certification density    | 40%      |    62.0 |
| AIQ survey score         | 35%      |    71.0 |
| Proficiency survey score | 25%      |    70.0 |

Composite AIQ score for the quarter: 68/100, an 11-point improvement over Q1, driven by the completion of the company-wide AI literacy certification program.
